name: Veil of the Weeping Widow

source.note: Fabled Heirloom from Memory's Rest; the book's numbers, our words.

summary: A Fabled Heirloom, Temperance: the veil lifted from her dead face. +1 to Wisdom checks and saves (+2 at level 7, +3 at 13), Resistance to Psychic damage, and Sense Grief (Detect Thoughts) once a dusk. From level 7, Psychic Shock: made to save against a charm or a fear, the wearer's Reaction deals 2d8 Psychic to whoever forced it.
